sents.zh: 清朝快要过去的时候，中国有很多难事。
sents.en: As the Qing dynasty was ending, China had many difficulties.

sents.zh: 西边的国家有新的船和新的东西。
sents.en: Countries to the west had new ships and new things.
Their ships were fast and large.

sents.zh: 很多中国人开始想：我们要学新的东西。
sents.en: Many Chinese began to think: we must learn new things.

sents.zh: 年轻人想学西边的学问。
sents.en: Young people wanted to learn western learning.

sents.zh: 一些官说，中国要有新的学校。
sents.en: Some officials said China needed new schools.

sents.zh: 他们也想有新的船和新的路。
sents.en: They wanted new ships and new roads too.
Doing these things was not easy.
But they did not give up.

sents.zh: 他们的想法影响了后来的中国。
sents.en: Their ideas shaped the China that came after.
